RS.eligibility: One meter per family unit in residence/apartment; exclusively residential. Mixed residential/commercial same meter, commercial/institutional/industrial premises and shared apartment facilities go to appropriate general service.

GS.eligibility: General service installations requiring Secondary Service, one meter per installation; no universal small-load ceiling in Schedule GS
GS.billing_demand: max(highest 30-minute integrated import kW,5.0,documented contract kW)
GS.history_ratchet: None in Sheet20; contract demand remains an independent floor and is not inferred from current DER-reduced demand.
GS.contract_rule: For new service after2009-04-30 or significant change:60% expected typical monthly peak; old contracts retained; company may require revised contract for increase; customer may request reevaluation at most once per12months. Input must be verified utility-assigned contract.
GS.non_demand_meter_rule: For customers without demand meter and >1000kWh/month, measured demand=kWh/200; proposed implementation excludes estimated/unmetered demand.
GS.reactive_charge: Three-phase customers only; $.36/rkVA before2026-03-01, $.60 thereafter; single-phase scope avoids this component.
unverified_or_excluded: Special Time-of-Day/Interval Metering fees unless confirmed absent

billing.cycle: Monthly, typically approximately30days; complete calendar cycles are a narrower model scope.
billing.season: Summer serviceJun1-Aug31;winterSep1-May31 unless component says otherwise.
billing.effective_basis: Non-seasonal rates begin with service rendered on stated effective date.
billing.partial_allocation: No general fixed-charge allocation rule verified for irregular/split cycles; exclude partial cycles and whole calendar cycles crossing midmonth component transition unless independently verified.
billing.minimum: No separate minimum-bill clause in ordinaryRS/GS sheets; GS5kW/contract capacity floor always applies. PartialService has separate minimums and is excluded.
billing.supplier: SSO only, ordinary standardGEN; no shopping/CRES/aggregation/TOU/CPP/PTR/RTP/specials. Supplier changes follow regular meter reading and cannot split a billing month.

DER.ordinary_basis: OhioOAC4901:1-10-28(B)(4) effective2024-04-08 requires standard netmetering retail structure/components/monthlycharges identical to noncustomer-generator. TariffSheet93 applies underlying schedule and import-only peakdemand;Sheet46 excludes NEMqualifying generation.
DER.eligibility: Onsite qualifying solar primarily offsetting own requirements; approved sizing <=120% of requirements determined from prior3-year average or utilityreasonableestimate.
required_evidence: Utility eligibility and ordinary/NEM billing confirmation for exact PV and paired-storage configuration
Written interconnection agreement and final permissiontooperate before study
DER.mode: Zeroexports,zerocreditbank; PV-only batterycharging as conservative modelrestriction. No standalonestorage; no verified exportsettlement.
DER.storage: Utility interconnection page expressly includes storageequipment in siteplan/oneline/application. This is not automatic NEMqualification; approval of exact pairedconfiguration required.
DER.sizing_bound: <=25kWcombined output may be selected as conservative modeling level1 bound; it is not an automatic approval or universal tariffeligibility bound.
DER.source_conflict: OldSheet93 allows requested annualrefund; currentOAC requires continuous monetarycarryforward/no cashpayment requirement. Rejectingexports/creditbanks avoids claiming either settlement.

PJM.separation: PJM control/zone metadata never determines utility eligibility, retailGEN/riders, chosen wholesaleLMP node or regional-averagecarbon intensity. FE Ohio energyzone combinesOE,CEI,TE;NSPL/transmissionallocation kept companyspecific.
